label: No placebo
rationale: This is an interventional but nonrandomized, single-group imaging study with MRI and electrophysiological tests; there is no inactive or active-placebo comparator described. The inclusion of healthy controls is a separate comparison group, not a placebo arm, and no sham procedure is mentioned.

evidence.quote: MRI will be done on ALS patients at baseline, at 3 month and at 6 month intervals.
Healthy controls will also be recruited and will be age- and gender-matched to patients.

title: New Magnetic Resonance Imaging Biomarkers in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
